214056: Yume moves in with her ex-boyfriend Mizuto Irido when their parents remarry. Loves reading, especially mystery novels. Used to be quite introverted and shy but put in the effort to socialize and become popular after entering high school.
214057: An introverted otaku girl that loves light novels. Despite generally poor grades, she was able to enter the same high-school as the rest of the characters, where she befriends Mizuto Irido due to their shared hobbies.
214058: Mizuto is a relatively introverted high-school boy with high intelligence and an interest in books of all kind. Moved in with his ex-girlfriend after their parents remarried.
214060: A cheerful, popular high school boy, and the self-proclaimed best friend of Mizuto Irido. He calls himself a "Read-Only Member" when it comes to love, declaring that he has no intention of pursuing it due to personal circumstances.
214061: A short, athletic high school girl, and a good friend of Yume Irido. She’s chirpy, great at interacting and up-to-date in fashion sense and makeup, but she has a tendency to become obsessive when she begins to care about or like someone, both in friendships and romance.
279386: Married to Yuni. Mizuto's father and Yume's stepfather.
